threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You think you can catch a bus on a Sunday evening and actually make it on time. Good luck with that, mate.
Caught a glimpse of a street performer on the 33 last week, harmonica in hand, serenading a couple in the back. Not a bad way to ride home.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I saw a dad juggling three kids and a pizza box, all while arguing with the kebab guy about the best toppings.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can catch a live DJ mix at the local U-Bahn station here—just last week, I stumbled upon a banger while waiting for the tram on Sunday.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're from here if they can name the bus route that runs late night better than their gym schedule. It's a survival skill, not a choice.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today with a guy debating philosophy with the driver. Only in the Tenderloin does a bus stop feel like a community college lecture.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just a hipster hub, but the real charm is in the quiet plazas where locals sip coffee and watch the world pass by.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they marvel at the metro's 'first' and 'last' service signs; locals know it’s just a daily headache.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Overground' instead of pretending it's a ‘train’ like the rest of us. Just wait till you get caught in a tube strike.
Caught a whiff of jerk chicken from a takeaway on Coldharbour while waiting for the 333. It’s like a midnight feast in the air.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a neighbor setting up a makeshift café in the park, complete with fairy lights and mismatched mugs, I knew I was in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a random art installation made of discarded bikes, just sitting on a corner, turning heads and sparking conversations.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they don’t flinch at a BART delay but groan when they see tourists fumbling with Muni maps on the corner.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus where a guy serenaded the whole ride with his ukulele. Strangest part? Everyone sang along like it was a concert.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals flock to Parc Güell, but most of us prefer the cozy sardanas at Plaça del Sol—much better vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot a recent arrival by their hesitant use of the metro—still fumbling with the T-10 card and unsure of the stations.
